profile.visual_desc: Hulking dark blue demon with a muscular build. Wears an olive-drab waist-wrap with red lining and dark bandages on wrists and ankles. Bare, powerful back is visible.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic, rocky face with glowing blue eyes and heavy brows. Features a monolithic, dark blue complexion with an intense, steady expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Golden energy-infused fists; no physical weapon held.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Crouched, low-center-of-gravity stance with back to camera and fists ready.
profile.step2_windup: Right fist pulls back and rises toward the shoulder, coiling the body for a heavy strike.
profile.step3_impact: Swings arm in a wide downward arc. A large, crescent-shaped golden energy slash appears, sweeping from top to bottom.
profile.step4_finish: Arm follows through toward the ground as the golden energy trail fades and the character recovers pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The vertical golden energy arc in Frame 4 precisely tracks the downward swing path of the right fist.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence accurately reflects reference wind-up and swing mechanics. VFX timing and anatomical alignment are consistent across the expanded frame count.
